# Machine Learning with R

This course teaches practical machine learning workflows in R for health data science, from data preparation to model evaluation and interpretation.

## Target Audience

Clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and data analysts who want to build and evaluate predictive models for biomedical or public health data.

## Practical Information

| Item | Information |
|---|---|
| Format | Online |
| Schedule | Monday, Wednesday, Friday |
| Time | 17:00-19:00 Morocco time |
| Price | 1500 DH |
| Seats | 20 participants maximum |
| Registration | Opens 10 days before course start |

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

- prepare health datasets for supervised learning;
- train and compare common machine learning models in R;
- evaluate classification and regression performance;
- use resampling and validation strategies;
- interpret model outputs for applied health research.
